import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    nums = list(map(int, data))
    N, M, L, R = nums[0], nums[1], nums[2], nums[3]

    cells = N * M
    base = R - L + 1
    result = pow(base, cells, MOD)

    if cells % 2 == 1:
        print(result)
    else:
        if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
            result = (result + 1) % MOD
        inv2 = (MOD + 1) // 2
        result = (result * inv2) % MOD
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
